high_level_description: The image features a black and white illustration of the Eye of Horus, an ancient Egyptian symbol often associated with protection, royal power, and good health. The eye is depicted with a cross-like symbol (the Ankh) at its center, which represents life and immortality. Below the eye, there is a stylized depiction of the Djed pillar, another significant Egyptian symbol that represents stability and strength. Beneath the illustration, there is a quote in quotation marks: "There is no going back once you have seen the truth.
